specimen.pocket: THE TIP STOPS. THE BODY DOESN'T. CONTACT TURNS A THRUST INTO A LEVER.

source.name: Spear
observed: Whole sheet contains compact/ready, low-line, long horizontal, high/diagonal spear envelopes and consequence-like/fallen states.
Long weapon occupancy is created by root, torso, arms and shaft together rather than arm telescoping alone.
Shaft volume matters on both sides of the hands.

direction.quality_thesis: Distal contact pins first; root momentum continues and visibly rotates the shaft/body system around that contact. Release then exposes stored angular debt as counterswing, butt-end lag, support catch and displaced recovery.
direction.coordinate_convention: +X = thrust direction; +Y screen-down in ASCII grid
direction.hit_stop: INFERRED emphasis at K04/K05; source-authentic duration UNKNOWN
direction.transition_policy: Authored keys own contact/support/root/tool state. Deterministic one-frame interpolation is permitted only between keys whose contact and support topology are unchanged; otherwise the next authored key snaps the causal change.

keys.name: READY_OFFSET
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root compact and slightly rear of final recovery address.

keys.name: ASYMMETRIC_COIL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis drops and shifts rearward while shaft compresses without losing forward line.

keys.name: LINE_EARNED
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root begins forward spend; hands resolve one thrust line before fastest travel.

keys.name: PRECONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root and front support chase the tip; contact still open one beat before impact.

keys.name: TIP_CONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Tip pins at wall while root still owns forward momentum; this is not farthest-reach endpoint decoration.

keys.name: ROOT_OVERRUN_PINNED
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root advances beneath a fixed tip; hands migrate and shaft angle changes around distal contact.

keys.name: LEVER_MAX
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis compresses and passes the thrust line; rear shaft rises while tip remains fixed, making angular debt unmistakable.

keys.name: CONTACT_RELEASE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Tip unpins only after lever maximum; root begins recoil while the shaft still carries clockwise debt.

keys.name: COUNTERSWING_OVERSHOOT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root recoils but shaft overshoots above the old axis; recovery is not reverse interpolation.

keys.name: BUTT_END_LAG
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Torso recenters before rear shaft; butt-end remains high and late, visibly separating body recovery from tool lag.

keys.name: SUPPORT_CATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Front foot returns, pelvis absorbs residual rotation, shaft drops through a compact catch arc.

keys.name: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body settles action-capable three cells forward of start; residual shaft angle and root displacement visibly preserve the event.

keys.name: READY_REENTRY_DISPLACED
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Re-entry restores options at a clearly displaced root address; compact shaft envelope does not erase the impact history.
